name: Statistical Charts
roadmap: Master the visual analysis of data. From identifying outliers in Stem-and-Leaf diagrams to interpreting dispersion in Box Plots and extracting percentiles from Ogives.
roadmap_zh: 精通數據視覺化分析。從識別幹葉圖中的離群值，到解釋盒形圖中的離散程度，以及從累積頻率曲線中提取百分位數。

concepts.name: Stem-and-Leaf Diagrams
concepts.key_takeaway: A Stem-and-Leaf diagram displays data by splitting each value into a 'stem' (the first digit or digits) and a 'leaf' (the last digit). This format allows you to see the distribution of data while retaining the original values. To accurately find the median, mode, and range, the leaves must be arranged in ascending order within each stem.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 幹葉圖通過將每個數值分為「莖」（前面的數位）和「葉」（最後一個數位）來顯示數據。這種格式讓你在保留原始數值的同時，也能觀察數據的分佈。為了準確地找出中位數、眾數和全距，每個莖部的葉子必須按升序排列。

concepts.name: Box-and-Whisker Diagrams
concepts.key_takeaway: Box plots provide a visual summary of data using five key values: the Minimum, Lower Quartile (Q1), Median, Upper Quartile (Q3), and Maximum. These points define the dispersion of the data. The Interquartile Range (IQR = Q3 - Q1) represents the spread of the middle 50% of the data, while the Range (Maximum - Minimum) shows the total spread.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 盒形圖利用五個關鍵數值對數據進行視覺化總結：最小值、下四分位數 (Q1)、中位數、上四分位數 (Q3) 及最大值。這些點定義了數據的離散程度。四分位位距 (IQR = Q3 - Q1) 代表中間 50% 數據的寬度，而全距 (最大值 - 最小值) 則顯示了整體的寬度。

concepts.name: Cumulative Frequency Polygons
concepts.key_takeaway: A Cumulative Frequency Polygon, or Ogive, is a curve that tracks the running total of frequencies. It is used to estimate percentiles such as the Median (50th percentile) and Quartiles (25th and 75th percentiles). To find the median, locate the 50% mark on the y-axis, move horizontally to hit the curve, and then look down to the corresponding value on the x-axis.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 累積頻率多邊形（又稱累積頻率曲線）是一條追蹤頻率累積總和的曲線。它用於估算百分位數，例如中位數（第 50 百分位數）及四分位數（第 25 和第 75 百分位數）。若要找出中位數，先在 y 軸找出 50% 的位置，水平移動直到接觸曲線，然後向下看 x 軸對應的數值。
